about.description:
This project is developed by Yeoulgame.
A perfect SSH client for game developers and players.
about.selfSigned:
It is signed by Yeoulgame rather than a public certificate authority, so Windows may warn that the publisher cannot be verified. This does not affect how the program works.
Always download from the official Yeoulgame sources (yeoulgame.com/board/files or github.com/yeoulgame/yeoulgame-ssh-client) and verify the SHA-256 hash and signature before installing.
about.verifyGuide: How to verify the hash and signature

help.title: Help
help.s1body: Choose File > New Connection (Ctrl+Shift+N) and enter the host, port and username. Turn on 'Add to saved sessions' and next time one click in the left panel connects you.
help.s2body: This is almost always an encoding mismatch. Pick UTF-8 or EUC-KR (CP949) explicitly under Session > Encoding. The default 'Auto detect' decides from the first bytes the server sends. On Linux also check `export LANG=ko_KR.UTF-8` and install the Noto Sans CJK fonts.
help.s3body:
Ctrl+Shift+T opens a tab, Ctrl+Shift+W closes one. Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab move between tabs. Double-click a tab to rename it.
Every application shortcut uses Ctrl+Shift so that shell keys such as Ctrl+C (interrupt), Ctrl+R (history search) and Ctrl+W (delete word) keep working.
help.s4body: Select with the mouse, then Ctrl+Shift+C to copy and Ctrl+Shift+V to paste. 'Copy on selection' and 'Right click pastes' can be enabled in Settings.
help.s5body: The buttons at the bottom run frequently used commands. Add or edit them under Tools > Edit Quick Commands.
help.s6body: Saved passwords are encrypted with the OS keychain (Windows DPAPI / libsecret). Where no keychain exists, set a master password under Tools > Master Password and credentials are stored with AES-256-GCM. Exported session files never contain passwords.
help.s7body: Check that keep-alive (60s by default) and automatic reconnect are enabled in Settings > Connection. Reconnection backs off from 2 seconds and stops after 5 attempts.
